identification: Sterling silver helmet-shaped cream jug on square pedestal foot, reeded rim and high loop handle. Marks in a row: crescent (worn), small rectangular mark, lion passant (or similar), letter C date mark. Likely Edwardian or early 20th century revival of a 1790s form; maker not legible and city/date unconfirmed. Photos 1-3 viewed.
